headline: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates — Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has informed the Exchange about the completion of acquisition of Autoelectric Group by Motherson Global Investments B.V., an indirect wholly owned subsidiary, on July 3, 2026.
